problem_statement: A common bit utility is needed that counts, for two byte arrays, the number of consecutive matching bits starting from the most-significant bit of the first byte, up to a caller-supplied maximum bit length, and returns that matched length. The utility must be declared and available for callers (it is referenced by the test suite). When two inputs fully match across the requested length it must return that length; when they differ at some bit it must return the position of the first differing bit. Without the utility, code that relies on it does not compile.
